Lena: Quick catch 1: model card for zephyr-mini-embed shows a 1024-dim example but runtime now returns 768. Also the catalog's benchmark link 404s. Anyone can take this?
Omar: I'll take it. Plan: update example vectors to 768, fix bench link, add a small compatibility note about quantized variants falling back to CPU on non-AVX2 machines.
Lena: Add an SDK migration snippet too so users explicitly pin model.
Omar: Snippet below (tiny): ```js
// pin model to avoid ambiguous defaults
const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: "zephyr-mini-embed-768", input: ["hi"] });
console.log(r.data[0].embedding.length); // 768
```
QA: Please add a unit test in docs CI asserting example fixture length === 768 and update benchmarks page to note seq_len=256 for throughput runs (previously shown at 512).
DocsBot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 by Omar (draft). Labels: docs, needs-review.
Lena: Infra review requested for the compat wording. Also add a short limits line: max_input_tokens = 4096; effective bench seq = 256.
Omar: Will update and add a redirect meta for archived pages that still point to /bench/zephyr-mini.
QA: Ran example locally against staging, embedding length 768. Ready to mark PR ready after CI passes.
Lena: Thanks 44D
